entries.title: Psalms 127:1
segments: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they labor in vain who build it; unless the LORD keeps the city, the watchman stays awake in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 127:2
segments: [It is] vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows; [for] so He gives His beloved sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 127:3
segments: Lo, children [are] the inheritance of the LORD; the fruit of the womb [is] a reward.

entries.title: Psalms 127:4
segments: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so [are] the sons of the young.

entries.title: Psalms 127:5
segments: Blessed [is] the man who has his quiver full of them; they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
